calls.head: The Red Wings aren’t Daccord’s kryptonite
calls.body: Daccord has been shaky against the Red Wings since 2023-24, well below his usual. It looks like a pattern, but across three seasons a goalie’s record against one team told us nothing about the next meeting. Expect the usual Daccord.
calls.call: If Daccord starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .911 than to his .870 against the Red Wings.
calls.nums: 6 starts against Detroit: .870 save percentage · .911 against everyone else
calls.cite: Goalie starts since 2023-24 · 6 against Detroit, 4,103 shots against everyone else
calls.happened: He didn’t start, so this call can’t be judged.

calls.head: Special teams lean toward the Red Wings
calls.body: The Red Wings’ power play is one of the league’s best, and the Kraken’s kill is one of the league’s worst. The Kraken need to stay out of the box.
calls.call: The Red Wings’ power play creates at least their usual 8.6 expected goals per 60.
calls.nums: Detroit 4th for power play (8.6 expected goals per 60) · Seattle 28th for penalty kill
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 3 and 4 games this season
calls.happened: Detroit’s power play created 4.5 expected goals per 60 in 3:05 of 5-on-4 time, against their usual 8.6, and scored 1 goal.

DET.head: We had this close to even (59% for Detroit), and it went Seattle’s way.

SEA.head: We had this close to even (41% for Seattle), and Seattle came through.

surprises.head: A rough night for J. Gibson
surprises.body: J. Gibson allowed 5 goals on shots worth 2.2 expected goals, 2.8 more than expected. Starting goalies had a night this rough about once every 25 starts over the last three seasons.

surprises.head: Detroit leaned on their bottom six
surprises.body: Detroit’s bottom-six forwards played 45% of the forwards’ 5-on-5 time, against their usual 40% and a league average of 42%. A team strays this far about once every 20 games.

story.head: The Kraken beat the Red Wings
paras: Viktor Arvidsson opened the scoring midway through the first. Frederick Gaudreau added two goals. Five different Kraken scored. Twice the Kraken answered a Red Wings lead. Detroit pulled John Gibson after five goals.
The chances were closer than the score. By our Swing measure, Berkly Catton had the best night of anyone.
